name: threat-model-suite
description: Agentic security-assessment suite — threat modeling, privacy impact, and compliance analysis — with a deterministic manifest-validation hard gate enforced by a PreToolUse hook before report generation, plus an offline diagram render toolchain (Mermaid + D2) gated by a fail-loud renderer preflight.

renderToolchain.note: Diagram rendering is offline/hermetic. The skill ships its render scripts (skills/threat-model/scripts/: render_diagrams.sh, ensure_renderer.sh, recon_to_d2.py) and the vendored typed-icon set (skills/threat-model/references/icons/, Material Design Icons, Apache-2.0). Renderer BINARIES are intentionally NOT committed — install them per your OS; the fail-loud preflight (ensure_renderer.sh) surfaces any missing binary/asset at pipeline start rather than as a blank diagram mid-run.

d2.purpose: .d2 -> offline SVG (HTML report) + PNG; free deterministic layout (ELK/dagre), never TALA or a remote layout

rsvg-convert.install: brew install librsvg  |  apt-get install -y librsvg2-bin

renderToolchain.preflight: skills/threat-model/scripts/ensure_renderer.sh [refs_dir] — run at pipeline start; exits nonzero naming any missing binary/asset and declares TM_RENDER_TIER=primary|fallback.
